lesson.title: Trust the DHCP uplink
lesson.goal: A rogue server could answer DHCP through any wall port. Trust only the uplink to DhcpServer so DeskPC gets a real lease.

step.text: DHCP snooping is already on for Closet, but no port is trusted, so offers are refused and DeskPC has no address.
Decide which port faces the real DHCP server: it is the uplink FastEthernet0/1.
Enter interface FastEthernet0/1 and run ip dhcp snooping trust.
On DeskPC run ipconfig /renew; a lease from DhcpServer appears in show ip dhcp snooping binding.

check.label: DeskPC has a DHCP lease from the trusted uplink
